title: docs(desktop): note publisher-signed macOS installs aren't replaced by a locally signed rebuild
claim: hermes update never swaps a publisher-signed /Applications/Hermes.app for a locally signed (or different Team ID / bundle id) rebuild; it keeps it and reports why.

evidence.doc_text_on_main: website/docs/getting-started/updating.md:141 — "On macOS the rebuilt bundle is then copied (with `ditto`, signature intact) over a stale `/Applications/Hermes.app` ..." (no exception for publisher-signed installs)
